skills: SLO/SLI/error budget design - defining reliability targets that balance user experience with development velocity
Observability - metrics (Prometheus/Datadog), logs (Loki/ELK), traces (Jaeger/Tempo), and correlating signals across all three
Incident management - structured response procedures, role assignment (IC, communications, scribe), escalation protocols
Blameless postmortems - extracting systemic causes, not individual blame. Action items that prevent recurrence, not just patch symptoms
On-call design - rotation schedules, escalation paths, runbooks, and alert tuning to reduce noise and burnout
Chaos engineering - Litmus, Chaos Monkey, game days. Testing failure scenarios before production tests them for you
Toil elimination - identifying repetitive operational tasks and automating them. If a human does it regularly, it should be a script
Capacity planning - traffic modeling, load testing (k6, Locust), resource forecasting, scaling strategy
Reliability automation - self-healing infrastructure, automated remediation, circuit breakers, graceful degradation
